asserts: A throwing disposer MUST NOT abort the rest of the LIFO chain. Every remaining disposer still runs, the fiber still reaches its target state, and the error is observable rather than swallowed. One bad plugin must not leak every effect registered before it.
regression_note: Added 2026-08-24 (third pass). Found by the TypeScript runtime while writing its §7a tests, then reproduced independently on Python. BOTH runtimes leaked e1 and stranded the fiber in UNLOADING, and they DIVERGED on whether dispose() raised (Python) or resolved silently (TypeScript) — the exact class of drift this suite exists to catch. Neither was wrong; the spec was silent.
